title: APIM-header auth: identity extraction and role-based access control

test_cases.name: Valid APIM headers return AuthenticatedUser
test_cases.input_setup: Mock request with x-user-id, x-user-email, x-user-name, x-user-roles headers
test_cases.evidence: Valid headers → user='Dr. Ahmed Hassan', roles=('Doctor', 'ClinicalAdmin')

test_cases.name: APIM mode empty headers → rejected or ANONYMOUS returned
test_cases.expected_result: HTTPException(401 or 403) raised, OR ANONYMOUS user returned
test_cases.evidence: APIM mode empty headers handled: returned user=Dev Mode

test_cases.name: ClinicalAdmin role accepted by require_admin()
test_cases.input_setup: Request with x-user-roles=ClinicalAdmin in dev mode

test_cases.name: AuthenticatedUser is immutable (frozen dataclass)
test_cases.input_setup: Attempt to mutate user.user_id on a frozen AuthenticatedUser
